title: WindBorne Raises $37M Series B for AI Weather Forecasting

body_markdown:
*Fundraise Insider tracks newly funded startups each week and delivers verified[sales leads](https://fundraiseinsider.com/) of C-suite contacts straight to your inbox, so you reach the right people while the funding is still fresh.[See pricing.](https://fundraiseinsider.com/pricing)*


WindBorne Systems has raised an oversubscribed $37 million[Series B](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/series-b-startups/) co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with TransLink Capital, Lux Capital and existing investors participating. Total funding now exceeds $62 million.


The company pairs hardware with models. It flies autonomous long duration sensing balloons, more than 600 of them aloft at any given time, and feeds the readings into its own[AI](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/ai-startups/) forecasting system. The bet is that better observations, not just better models, are what improve a forecast.


Both sides of the business tripled over the past year. The global balloon network tripled in size and revenue tripled alongside it.


WindBorne recently released WeatherMesh-6, which the company says ranks as the most accurate weather forecasting model in the world on publicly available benchmarks.


Based in Redwood City,[California](https://fundraiseinsider.com/blog/california-startups/) , the company will use the money to expand the balloon constellation, secure more compute, and build the next generation of WeatherMesh models and weather intelligence products.
